## Repository.findSingleByQuery() method

Find a single record by query. Returns null if not found.

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
findSingleByQuery(query: Query<T>): Promise<T | null>;
```

## Parameters

|  Parameter | Type | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
|  query | Query&lt;T&gt; | the query |

<b>Returns:</b>

Promise&lt;T \| null&gt;

the record, or null if not found

## Exceptions

{<!-- -->RecordDuplicateError<!-- -->} if multiple records are found for the given query
